# Axel Hufford

> Axel Hufford is an appellate lawyer at Jenner & Block in Washington, D.C. He also builds small websites about courts, elections, movies, and basketball.

This is a plain-text summary of https://axelhufford.com, his personal site, for language models and other automated readers. The site is a single page listing his projects and selected legal writing.

## About

- Practice: Associate in the Appellate and Supreme Court practice at Jenner & Block LLP, Washington, D.C. Constitutional and administrative law, with a focus on election law, the separation of powers, and the First Amendment. Firm bio: https://www.jenner.com/en/people/axel-j-hufford
- Clerkships: Judge Alison J. Nathan, U.S. Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit; Judge Ronnie Abrams, U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York
- Education: J.D., Stanford Law School, 2022; B.A., Dartmouth College, 2016
- Before law: Fulbright English teacher in Samcheonpo, South Korea; business analyst at Deloitte Consulting
- Also known as: Axel J. Hufford

## Projects

- [Good Behaviour](https://goodbehaviour.org): A seat-by-seat history of the Supreme Court and the federal courts, from 1789 to today. Public JSON feed of the current Court: https://goodbehaviour.org/api/v1/court.json
- [The Proportional House](https://proportionalhouse.org): Mapping the U.S. House under proportional representation—how the chamber would change if seats matched the popular vote. Public JSON feed: https://proportionalhouse.org/api/v1/projection.json
- [Movi](https://movirank.com): Every movie ranked, one matchup at a time. Compare, rank, and discover films with friends.
- [4th Quarter](https://4th-quarter-sooty.vercel.app): Skip the first three. Catch the fourth. Get notified when your NBA team's game hits the final quarter.

Mi Familia Vota, No. 25-1017, U.S. Supreme Court, Oct. 2026 (PDF)

California, No. 26A305, U.S. Supreme Court, Sept. 2026 (PDF)
